none: PAS CAM-B74111: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy nummus of Constantine II, AD 317-340
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [GLORIA EXERCITVS] ; D/ CONST[ANTINVS] IVN NOB C

A copper-alloy nummus of Constantine II, AD 317-340 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Reverse shows two soldiers and one standard. Mint is uncertain, AD 335-340. Obverse legend reads CONST[ANTINVS] IVN NOB C. Obverse shows a laureate and cuirassed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]. Die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight is 1.39g, diameter is 15.4mm, thickness…
